name: Mickey "@HackingThings" Shkatov
biography: Mickey has been involved in security research for over a decade, specializing in breaking down complex concepts and identifying security vulnerabilities in unusual places. His experience spans a variety of topics, which he has presented at security conferences worldwide. His talks have covered areas ranging from web penetration testing to the intricacies of BIOS firmware.
